name: Orzea
source: The current ruler of Orzea Kingdom and the older brother of Pedoe. Much like his younger brother, he has an uncanny obsession: cookies. To say its the only thing he cares about is probably not an exaggeration, which makes it questionable if such a person is truly capable of leading a kingdom.
